title: Chapter 465 Ye Xueer'S Back
content:
Chapter 465 Ye Xueer'S Back

"What about us?"

Ye Hui replied: "The Ice Frost Empire has three strongest kings. The empire that was originally willing to ally with us has now broken its agreement and remained neutral. The strongest kings that my grandfather can invite, including my brother, are at most three."

The situation is quite bad.

Wang Shuo felt that he must be prepared to run away at any time.

"Part of my Ye family bloodline has been dispersed, but these people who are stranded outside will definitely be hunted down, so they must be protected by local forces."

"I am very moved that these brothers can come in person. If Sky City can't be defended, it may be God's will."

...

The three of them talked until midnight, and Ye Hui immediately ordered someone to arrange a good side hall for Wang Shuo to rest.

Accompanied by the palace maids, Wang Shuo came to an exquisite courtyard.

The courtyard was brightly lit. Wang Shuo entered the house, his eyes fixed, and found the back of a girl.

Wang Shuo was wondering secretly. It was impossible for that maid to stand proudly in the hall in the middle of the night.

Wang Shuo looked at the back and felt familiar for a moment, but he seemed to have no impression.

After all, the backs of beautiful girls are all the same.

"Excuse me, girl?" Wang Shuo asked softly.

The girl turned around, and her fair and slightly plump face looked a little rosy under the candlelight.

Wang Shuo was struck by lightning and stood there for a while.

The long-lost heartbeat made his breathing quicken.

"Ye Xueer?"

Wang Shuo thought that he might meet Ye Xueer when he came to the Sky City, but he didn't expect to meet in this way.

As early as when Master Tongchui sent someone to invite Wang Shuo, he found Ye Xueer and asked her if she knew Wang Shuo, and talked about the importance of Wang Shuo to the crisis of the Sky City.

Before Master Tongchui could explain in detail, Ye Xueer agreed to meet Wang Shuo.

"Wang Shuo, long time no see!"

Ye Xueer smiled.

...

The next morning, Ye Xueer took Wang Shuo to tour the entire Sky City. The close combat atmosphere of the war did not affect Wang Shuo's good mood.

But Ye Xueer seemed to be saying goodbye to this city where she had lived for more than 20 years.

She knew in her heart that after this battle, Sky City would never be the same again.

"Wang Shuo, if possible, I still hope you can help Sky City to withstand this crisis."

Ye Xueer bit her lips and said with some sadness.

She also knew Wang Shuo's strength, and she knew that he had already established a Vana Empire comparable to the Frost Empire.

Wang Shuo looked at Ye Xueer's pretty face and said helplessly: "It is difficult for me to change the current situation of the Frost Empire. I can only promise that I will treat the Ye family who moved to the Vana Empire well."

Wang Shuo stood on an observation deck, looking at the prosperity of Sky City, and his heart was also a little more lonely.

The rise and fall of dynasties is like the cycle of heaven. Perhaps the Vana Empire cannot escape this fate!

A few days later, the Parthian Empire and the Truni Empire seemed to be ready.

Wang Shuo also put on his armor and came to the city wall.

Master Tongchui and Ye Hui, as well as several other strongest kings, gathered together.

Looking at the millions of troops under the city, Wang Shuo was still calm. Wang Shuo had seen this kind of scene many times.

Unlike before, Wang Shuo was very relaxed. After all, he was not defending his own territory. It would be best if he could win, but it didn't matter if he couldn't. He could just take Ye Xueer back to the Vana Empire.
